test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 24

questions.question: A class of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 70, and that of the rest is 64. What is the average score of the class?
If 9 : y :: y : 64, then find the positive value of y.

A man purchased two varieties of erasers at the rate of ₹2 for 3 erasers and ₹2 per eraser, respectively. If he purchased an equal number of erasers of each variety and then sold all his erasers at ₹2 per eraser, what was his profit percentage?
A cosmetic product is available at a discount of 11% on its marked price. If the shopkeeper charges ₹1,780, what is its marked price?

If 25 people, working for 10 hours a day, can complete 2 units of work in 4 days, then how many days will be required by 18 people to complete 18 units of work, if each person works for 10 hours a day?
A man receives ₹1,900 per month as salary. He saves 35% of his salary every month. His expenditure (in ₹) per month is:
For a trip of 600 km, a truck travels the first 300 km at a speed of 42 km/hr. At what speed (km/hr) should it cover the remaining distance, so that the average speed is 66 km/hr?

3584 is divided into three parts in such a way that half of the first part, one-fourth of the second part and one-eighth of the third part are equal. What is the difference between the first and second parts?
The population of a town in 1959 was 3,17,600. If its population increased in two successive decades by 45% in each decade, the population of the town in 1979 was:
The average of 13 numbers is 14. If each number is multiplied by 2, then what will the new average be?
The diagonals of a rhombus are 80 cm and 30 cm, respectively. The area of the rhombus (in cm2) is:

A trader offers a discount of 14% on the marked price of an article. How much percentage above the cost price should he mark the article to make a profit of 14%?(Give your answer rounded off to 2 decimal places.)

The difference (rounded off to one decimal place) between the compound interest (when interest is compounded annually) and the simple interest if ₹73,900 is deposited at 4% rate of interest per annum for 2 years is:
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 9 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 12 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?
The average of 13 numbers is 13. If each number is multiplied by 8, then what will the new average be?
In a cricket match, a batsman scored 120 runs, which included 9 fours and 5 sixes. What percentage of his total score did he make by running between the wickets?
The number of non-square integers between 2572 and 2582 is:
A man decides to travel 72 km in 10 hours partly by foot and partly on a bicycle. If his speed on foot is 6 km/hr and on the bicycle is 12 km/hr, what distance (in km) will he travel on foot?

A person borrows ₹46,300 at the rate of 10% compound interest per year, compounded annually. At the end of every year, he pays ₹1,900 as part payment. How much does he still owe after two such instalments?
The average of the first 299 even natural numbers is:
